NewsPage.soWhatExactlyIsMysteryGiftIsItSafeWhat: So what exactly is Mystery Gift? Is it safe? What can it do?
NewsPage.mysteryGiftIsAFeatureGamefreakProgrammed: Mystery Gift is a feature GameFreak programmed in the original FireRed / LeafGreen that allowed for event distribution. It was primarily used for sending the AuroraTicket and MysticTicket items via the wireless adapter. But it is much flexible and able to run almost any code sent. They have specific methods for receiving items, pokemon, and eggs. There is also support for things like sprites and music.
NewsPage.mysteryGiftContainsTwoMainComponentsAWon: Mystery Gift contains two main components: a Wonder Card and the script to run when you talk to the deliveryman on the 2nd floor of the Pokémon Center. The Wonder Card contains text to provide instructions for the player. The script is code stored in a special place on the file to run when needed and keep it isolated. If you delete the Wonder Card in the Mystery Gift menu, it also deletes the script so it is easy to remove any Mystery Gift data.

NewsPage.weHaveAWorkingPrototypeOfMysteryEventFor: We have a working prototype of Mystery Event for an unmodded Switch or Switch 2 FireRed / LeafGreen game. Come to Pokémon Worlds / XP in San Francisco to get an exclusive look!
NewsPage.thisWasAcheivedByBuildingOffOfPart1Torna: This was acheived by building off of <part1>tornadus's FRLG LDN trade project</part1>. By extending this project to support hosting trades and wireless adapter interactions, we can now send custom mystery gift events to stock, unmodded Switch 1 and Switch 2 FireRed / LeafGreen games with a simple linux and Wifi-USB adapter!
